```{ojs}
catData = FileAttachment("data/catalogue.json").json()
protSummary = catData.protein_summary
protIndex = catData.proteins_index
```

```{ojs}
platBadgeClass = p => p === "Mass Spectrometry" ? "plat-MS" : p === "Other Immunoassay" ? "plat-Other" : `plat-${p}`

dataBadgeClass = d =>
  d === "Genome-wide" ? "data-gw" :
  d === "Gene-region" ? "data-cis" :
  d === "Top-hits" ? "data-top" : "data-unavail"

curationBadgeClass = c =>
  c === "Human-curated" ? "cur-human-curated" :
  c === "Human-reviewed" ? "cur-human-reviewed" : "cur-ai-extracted"

matchNumericFilter = (val, rawExpr) => {
  const expr = (rawExpr || "").trim().replace(/,/g, "");
  if (!expr) return true;
  const m = expr.match(/^(>=|<=|>|<|=)?\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)$/);
  if (m) {
    const op = m[1] || ">=";
    const num = Number(m[2]);
    if (op === ">=") return val >= num;
    if (op === "<=") return val <= num;
    if (op === ">")  return val > num;
    if (op === "<")  return val < num;
    return val === num;
  }
  return String(val).includes(expr);
}
```

```{ojs}
mutable selectedUniprot = "P05231"
```

```{ojs}
// Top Banner + Protein Search Bar (persisted input so typing never loses focus)
{
  const chipContainer = htl.html`<div style="margin-top:0.55rem;"></div>`;

  const updateChips = (queryStr) => {
    const q = (queryStr || "").trim().toLowerCase();
    const matches = protSummary.filter(p =>
      !q || `${p.gene_symbol} ${p.uniprot} ${p.protein_name}`.toLowerCase().includes(q)
    );

    if (q && matches.length > 0 && !matches.some(m => m.uniprot === selectedUniprot)) {
      mutable selectedUniprot = matches[0].uniprot;
    }

    chipContainer.replaceChildren(
      ...matches.map(p => htl.html`<button
        class="quick-chip ${p.uniprot === selectedUniprot ? "active" : ""}"
        onclick=${() => {
          mutable selectedUniprot = p.uniprot;
          updateChips(searchInput.value);
        }}>
        <strong>${p.gene_symbol}</strong> <span class="mono" style="opacity:0.8;">${p.uniprot}</span>
        <span style="opacity:0.75;font-size:0.72rem;"> · ${p.protein_name}</span>
      </button>`)
    );
  };

  const searchInput = htl.html`<input
    class="col-filter-input"
    style="font-size:0.9rem;padding:0.5rem 0.75rem;"
    type="text"
    placeholder="Search protein by gene symbol (e.g. IL6, PCSK9, APOE), UniProt ID (e.g. P05231), or protein name..."
    oninput=${e => updateChips(e.target.value)}
  >`;

  updateChips("");

  return htl.html`<div class="pg-shell" style="padding-bottom:0;">
    <div class="hero-banner">
      <div>
        <h1>Protein Lookup</h1>
        <p>Search by UniProt accession, gene symbol, or protein name to inspect every study and assay in which that protein was measured.</p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="panel-card">
      <div style="font-size:0.74rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.04em;color:#475569;margin-bottom:0.35rem;">
        Select or Search Target Protein
      </div>
      ${searchInput}
      ${chipContainer}
    </div>
  </div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
activeProtMeta = protSummary.find(p => p.uniprot === selectedUniprot) || protSummary[0]

activeProtRows = protIndex
  .filter(r => r.uniprot === activeProtMeta.uniprot && r.status !== "Superseded Preprint")
  .sort((a, b) => (b.year - a.year) || (b.n_samples - a.n_samples))
```

```{ojs}
// Reusable Catalogue-style Full-Width Study Table for the Selected Protein (with inline column filters & expandable rows)
{
  const rowsSource = activeProtRows;
  const state = {
    sortCol: "n",
    sortAsc: false,
    expanded: new Set(),
    filters: {
      study: "",
      cohort: "",
      overlap: "",
      pop: "",
      sex: "",
      n: "",
      sample: "",
      platform: "",
      assay: "",
      data: ""
    }
  };

  const countSpan = htl.html`<span></span>`;
  const clearBtn = htl.html`<button class="btn-pill" style="display:none;padding:0.2rem 0.55rem;font-size:0.74rem;" onclick=${() => {
    for (const k of Object.keys(state.filters)) state.filters[k] = "";
    for (const el of filterInputs) el.value = "";
    renderRows();
  }}>✕ Clear column filters</button>`;

  const cols = [
    { key: "study",    label: "STUDY",    align: "left"  },
    { key: "cohort",   label: "COHORT",   align: "left"  },
    { key: "overlap",  label: "OVERLAP",  align: "left"  },
    { key: "pop",      label: "POP",      align: "left"  },
    { key: "sex",      label: "SEX",      align: "left"  },
    { key: "n",        label: "N",        align: "right" },
    { key: "sample",   label: "SAMPLE",   align: "left"  },
    { key: "platform", label: "PLATFORM", align: "left"  },
    { key: "assay",    label: "ASSAY ID", align: "right" },
    { key: "data",     label: "DATA",     align: "left"  }
  ];

  const sortIndicators = {};
  const sortHeaders = cols.map(col => {
    const ind = htl.html`<span style="opacity:0.55;margin-left:3px;font-size:0.68rem;">↕</span>`;
    sortIndicators[col.key] = ind;
    return htl.html`<th style="text-align:${col.align};" onclick=${() => {
      if (state.sortCol === col.key) state.sortAsc = !state.sortAsc;
      else {
        state.sortCol = col.key;
        state.sortAsc = col.key === "n" || col.key === "study" || col.key === "overlap" ? false : true;
      }
      renderRows();
    }}>${col.label}${ind}</th>`;
  });

  const filterInputs = [];
  const makeTextFilter = (key, placeholder) => {
    const inp = htl.html`<input class="col-filter-input" type="text" placeholder=${placeholder} oninput=${e => {
      state.filters[key] = e.target.value;
      renderRows();
    }}>`;
    filterInputs.push(inp);
    return inp;
  };
  const makeSelectFilter = (key, options) => {
    const sel = htl.html`<select class="col-filter-select" onchange=${e => {
      state.filters[key] = e.target.value;
      renderRows();
    }}>
      <option value="">All</option>
      ${options.map(o => htl.html`<option value=${o}>${o}</option>`)}
    </select>`;
    filterInputs.push(sel);
    return sel;
  };

  const filterRow = htl.html`<tr class="filter-row">
    <th>${makeTextFilter("study", "Author, year, PMID...")}</th>
    <th>${makeTextFilter("cohort", "UKB, INTERVAL...")}</th>
    <th>${makeTextFilter("overlap", "None, >0, study...")}</th>
    <th>${makeTextFilter("pop", "Ancestry...")}</th>
    <th>${makeSelectFilter("sex", ["Combined", "Female", "Male"])}</th>
    <th>${makeTextFilter("n", ">=1000")}</th>
    <th>${makeTextFilter("sample", "Plasma, serum, CSF...")}</th>
    <th>${makeTextFilter("platform", "SomaScan, Olink...")}</th>
    <th>${makeTextFilter("assay", "OID..., SeqId...")}</th>
    <th>${makeSelectFilter("data", ["Genome-wide", "Gene-region", "Top-hits", "Unavailable"])}</th>
  </tr>`;

  const tbody = htl.html`<tbody></tbody>`;

  function getFiltered() {
    const f = state.filters;
    const rows = rowsSource.filter(d => {
      if (f.study && !`${d.first_author} ${d.year} ${d.pmid || ""} ${d.doi || ""}`.toLowerCase().includes(f.study.toLowerCase())) return false;
      if (f.cohort && !d.cohorts_display.toLowerCase().includes(f.cohort.toLowerCase())) return false;
      if (f.overlap) {
        const q = f.overlap.trim().toLowerCase();
        if (q === ">0" || q === "yes") {
          if (d.overlap_count === 0) return false;
        } else if (!`${d.overlap_compact} ${d.overlap_details}`.toLowerCase().includes(q)) return false;
      }
      if (f.pop && !`${d.ancestry_detail} ${d.ancestry_group}`.toLowerCase().includes(f.pop.toLowerCase())) return false;
      if (f.sex && d.sex !== f.sex) return false;
      if (f.n && !matchNumericFilter(d.n_samples, f.n)) return false;
      if (f.sample && !d.sample_matrix.toLowerCase().includes(f.sample.toLowerCase())) return false;
      if (f.platform && !`${d.platform_category} ${d.platform_version}`.toLowerCase().includes(f.platform.toLowerCase())) return false;
      if (f.assay && !`${d.assay_id} ${d.n_assays}`.toLowerCase().includes(f.assay.toLowerCase())) return false;
      if (f.data && d.data_label !== f.data) return false;
      return true;
    });

    const dir = state.sortAsc ? 1 : -1;
    rows.sort((a, b) => {
      switch (state.sortCol) {
        case "study":    return dir * ((a.year - b.year) || a.first_author.localeCompare(b.first_author));
        case "cohort":   return dir * a.cohorts_display.localeCompare(b.cohorts_display);
        case "overlap":  return dir * (a.overlap_count - b.overlap_count);
        case "pop":      return dir * a.ancestry_detail.localeCompare(b.ancestry_detail);
        case "sex":      return dir * a.sex.localeCompare(b.sex);
        case "n":        return dir * (a.n_samples - b.n_samples);
        case "sample":   return dir * a.sample_matrix.localeCompare(b.sample_matrix);
        case "platform": return dir * a.platform_version.localeCompare(b.platform_version);
        case "assay":    return dir * a.assay_id.localeCompare(b.assay_id);
        case "data":     return dir * a.data_label.localeCompare(b.data_label);
        default:         return dir * (a.n_samples - b.n_samples);
      }
    });
    return rows;
  }

  const downloadProteinTSV = () => {
    const rows = getFiltered();
    if (!rows.length) return;
    const header = ["gene_symbol", "uniprot", "assay_id", "stratum_id", "first_author", "year", "pmid", "doi", "cohorts_display", "overlap_compact", "ancestry_detail", "sex", "n_samples", "sample_matrix", "platform_version", "n_assays", "data_label", "genome_build", "strand", "accession_or_url"];
    const lines = [
      header.join("\t"),
      ...rows.map(r => header.map(c => r[c] == null ? "" : String(r[c]).replace(/\t|\n/g, " ")).join("\t"))
    ];
    const blob = new Blob([lines.join("\n")], { type: "text/tab-separated-values;charset=utf-8" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `${activeProtMeta.gene_symbol}_${activeProtMeta.uniprot}_studies.tsv`;
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  function renderRows() {
    for (const c of cols) {
      const ind = sortIndicators[c.key];
      if (state.sortCol === c.key) {
        ind.textContent = state.sortAsc ? " ↑" : " ↓";
        ind.style.opacity = "1";
      } else {
        ind.textContent = " ↕";
        ind.style.opacity = "0.45";
      }
    }
    clearBtn.style.display = Object.values(state.filters).some(v => v && v.trim() !== "") ? "inline-flex" : "none";

    const rows = getFiltered();
    countSpan.textContent = `Studies measuring ${activeProtMeta.gene_symbol} (${activeProtMeta.uniprot}): ${rows.length} assay-stratum rows · Click any row to expand details`;

    const trs = [];
    for (const d of rows) {
      const rowKey = `${d.stratum_id}__${d.assay_id}`;
      const isOpen = state.expanded.has(rowKey);
      const toggle = () => {
        if (state.expanded.has(rowKey)) state.expanded.delete(rowKey);
        else state.expanded.add(rowKey);
        renderRows();
      };

      trs.push(htl.html`<tr class="data-row ${isOpen ? "is-open" : ""}" onclick=${toggle}>
        <td>
          <div style="font-weight:600;color:#0f172a;">
            <span style="display:inline-block;width:12px;color:#64748b;font-size:0.7rem;">${isOpen ? "▾" : "▸"}</span>
            ${d.first_author} (${d.year})
          </div>
          <div class="mono" style="color:#64748b;padding-left:12px;">
            ${d.pmid ? `PMID: ${d.pmid}` : "Preprint"}
          </div>
        </td>
        <td>${d.cohorts_display}</td>
        <td>
          ${d.overlap_count > 0
            ? htl.html`<span class="pg-badge overlap-yes">${d.overlap_compact}</span>`
            : htl.html`<span class="overlap-none">None</span>`}
        </td>
        <td>${d.ancestry_detail}</td>
        <td>${d.sex}</td>
        <td class="num-col"><strong>${d.n_samples.toLocaleString()}</strong></td>
        <td>${d.sample_matrix}</td>
        <td>
          <span class="pg-badge ${platBadgeClass(d.platform_category)}">${d.platform_category}</span>
          <div style="font-size:0.72rem;color:#64748b;margin-top:1px;">${d.platform_version}</div>
        </td>
        <td class="num-col">
          <div style="font-weight:600;color:#0f4c81;">${d.assay_id}</div>
          <div style="font-size:0.7rem;color:#64748b;">(${d.n_assays.toLocaleString()} total)</div>
        </td>
        <td><span class="pg-badge ${dataBadgeClass(d.data_label)}">${d.data_label}</span></td>
      </tr>`);

      if (isOpen) {
        trs.push(htl.html`<tr class="detail-row">
          <td colspan="10">
            <div class="detail-topbar">
              <div>
                <p class="detail-title">${d.title}</p>
                <div style="font-size:0.78rem;color:#475569;margin-top:2px;">
                  <em>${d.journal}</em> (${d.year}) · Standardised protein ID: <span class="mono" style="color:#0f4c81;font-weight:600;">${d.uniprot}_${d.assay_id}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div class="detail-links">
                ${d.doi ? htl.html`<a class="btn-pill" href="https://doi.org/${d.doi}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">DOI: ${d.doi} ↗</a>` : ""}
                <a class="btn-pill btn-pill-primary" href=${d.accession_or_url} target="_blank" rel="noopener">Data Download (${d.repository}) ↗</a>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div class="detail-3col">
              <div class="detail-col-box">
                <h4>Phenotype Information</h4>
                <div class="detail-kv"><strong>Target assay ID:</strong> <span class="mono">${d.assay_id}</span> (${d.platform_version})</div>
                <div class="detail-kv"><strong>Study assay count:</strong> ${d.n_assays.toLocaleString()} assays</div>
                <div class="detail-kv"><strong>Sample matrix:</strong> ${d.sample_matrix}</div>
                <div class="detail-kv"><strong>Transformation:</strong> ${d.transformation} (<span class="mono">${d.effect_scale}</span>)</div>
              </div>

              <div class="detail-col-box">
                <h4>Genetic Information</h4>
                <div class="detail-kv"><strong>Genome build:</strong> <span class="mono" style="font-weight:700;">${d.genome_build}</span></div>
                <div class="detail-kv"><strong>Strand:</strong> <span class="mono" style="font-weight:700;">${d.strand || "Not reported"}</span></div>
                <div class="detail-kv"><strong>Model / software:</strong> ${d.gwas_software}</div>
                <div class="detail-kv"><strong>Covariates:</strong> ${d.covariates}</div>
                <div class="detail-kv"><strong>Cis-pQTL reported:</strong> ${d.cis_pqtl_reported ? "Yes" : "Not reported"}${d.pav_epitope_flag ? " · ⚠ PAV/epitope sensitive" : ""}</div>
              </div>

              <div class="detail-col-box">
                <h4>Other Information</h4>
                <div class="detail-kv"><strong>Curation provenance:</strong> <span class="pg-badge ${curationBadgeClass(d.curation_tier)}">${d.curation_tier}</span></div>
                <div class="detail-kv"><strong>Overlapping catalogue studies:</strong> ${d.overlap_details}</div>
                <div class="detail-kv"><strong>Data access &amp; format:</strong> ${d.access_level} · ${d.file_format}</div>
                <div class="detail-kv"><strong>Notes:</strong> ${d.harmonisation_notes}</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </td>
        </tr>`);
      }
    }

    if (trs.length === 0) {
      trs.push(htl.html`<tr><td colspan="10" style="text-align:center;padding:1.5rem;color:#64748b;">No studies match the current column filters for ${activeProtMeta.gene_symbol}.</td></tr>`);
    }
    tbody.replaceChildren(...trs);
  }

  renderRows();

  return htl.html`<div class="pg-shell" style="padding-top:0;padding-bottom:1rem;">
    <div class="table-toolbar">
      <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.75rem;flex-wrap:wrap;">
        ${countSpan}
        ${clearBtn}
      </div>
      <div>
        <button class="btn-pill btn-pill-primary" onclick=${downloadProteinTSV}>⬇ Download ${activeProtMeta.gene_symbol} Table (.tsv)</button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="cat-table-wrap">
      <table class="cat-table">
        <thead>
          <tr class="sort-row">${sortHeaders}</tr>
          ${filterRow}
        </thead>
        ${tbody}
      </table>
    </div>
  </div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
// Scatter / Bubble Figure Underneath the Protein Study Table
htl.html`<div class="pg-shell" style="padding-top:0;">
  <div class="panel-card">
    <div class="panel-title">
      <span>Studies Measuring ${activeProtMeta.gene_symbol} (${activeProtMeta.uniprot}) Over Time</span>
      <span style="font-size:0.78rem;font-weight:400;color:#64748b;">Bubble size = study assay count · Dashed outline = Preprint · Log10 sample size</span>
    </div>
    ${Plot.plot({
      width: 1150,
      height: 280,
      marginLeft: 65,
      marginRight: 30,
      marginBottom: 38,
      style: { background: "transparent", fontSize: "12px", width: "100%" },
      x: {
        label: "Publication / Preprint Year",
        tickFormat: d => String(d),
        domain: [
          activeProtRows.length ? Math.min(2016.5, Math.min(...activeProtRows.map(d => d.year)) - 0.5) : 2016.5,
          activeProtRows.length ? Math.max(2026.5, Math.max(...activeProtRows.map(d => d.year)) + 0.5) : 2026.5
        ]
      },
      y: {
        type: "log",
        label: "Sample Size N (log scale)",
        grid: true
      },
      r: { range: [5, 18] },
      color: {
        legend: true,
        domain: ["SomaScan", "Olink", "Mass Spectrometry", "NULISA", "Luminex", "Other Immunoassay"],
        range: ["#4338ca", "#0d9488", "#d97706", "#db2777", "#64748b", "#475569"]
      },
      marks: [
        Plot.dot(activeProtRows, {
          x: d => d.year + (d.ancestry_group === "EUR" ? -0.07 : d.ancestry_group === "Multi-ancestry" ? 0 : 0.1),
          y: "n_samples",
          r: "n_assays",
          fill: "platform_category",
          fillOpacity: d => d.status === "Preprint" ? 0.45 : 0.8,
          stroke: "platform_category",
          strokeWidth: d => d.status === "Preprint" ? 2 : 1,
          strokeDasharray: d => d.status === "Preprint" ? "3,2" : null,
          tip: true,
          title: d => `${d.first_author} (${d.year}) [${d.status}]\nAssay: ${d.assay_id} (${d.platform_version})\nCohort: ${d.cohorts_display} | Pop: ${d.ancestry_detail}\nN = ${d.n_samples.toLocaleString()} | Sample: ${d.sample_matrix}\nData: ${d.data_label}`
        })
      ]
    })}
  </div>
</div>`
```
